interface.longDescription:
Product Photos by RunComfy turns existing product photos into clean studio images, lifestyle scenes and campaign variants using compatible image models.

What you can do:
- Create a clean product image with a white or studio background.
- Place a product into a described lifestyle setting.
- Prepare a requested set of images for different scenes or formats.
- Define the product color, shape, label and material details to check against the original.

Connect a RunComfy account to generate images. Generations use your RunComfy account balance. Model choices and available dimensions depend on the current catalog.

Provide a product photo through an accessible HTTPS link. The plugin asks for a usable link if a chat attachment cannot be passed to the model. AI edits can change labels, geometry and fine details, so compare every result with the original before commercial use. A white background does not imply a transparent cutout. The plugin does not automatically publish images to an online store.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn a product photo into a clean studio image; explain which image link you need.
Help me plan a lifestyle photo for a ceramic mug, then ask for the product image needed to generate it.
Plan two campaign images from one product photo and explain what details I should check in the results.

publication.release_notes: Adds search keywords so the plugin is easier to find in the plugin directory. Tools, skills, listing text and review cases are unchanged from version 1.0.2.

positive.description: P1: clean studio product image; covers clean-product-photo.
positive.prompt: Use this illustrative headphones image: https://playgrounds-storage-public.runcomfy.net/tools/7425/media-files/output-example1-2.webp . Make one white-background studio image using Nano Banana 2 Edit if exposed. Preserve the black appearance, silhouette, cushions, headband, connectors and AERO lettering as closely as possible. Explain fidelity limits and cost, then wait for approval of one output.
positive.tools_triggered: list_models (when model discovery is needed), get_model, generate_image; after submission, get_model_request_status and get_model_request_result for the returned request ID. Use the current connected definitions and the selected model input schema.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the selected reference-capable model and its supported image inputs before execution. Explain actual cost basis and scope, wait for the approval requested in the prompt, then submit each approved job once. Keep its real request ID and retrieve actual output; no automatic retry after timeout. Use the actual supplied image, not a recreated text-only product. Return an image with a rendered white background, not a claimed transparent cutout. Compare visible product attributes when inspection is available and record P1 ID.

positive.description: P2: Chinese lifestyle scene; covers stage-product-scenes.
positive.prompt: 参考这张耳机示例图：https://playgrounds-storage-public.runcomfy.net/tools/7425/media-files/output-example1-2.webp 。做一张浅色石台、柔和侧光的生活场景商品图，尽量保留哑黑外形、耳垫、头梁、连接件和 AERO 字样。用 Qwen Image 3.0 Edit（若当前连接支持），先说方案和计费，等确认后只做一张。
positive.tools_triggered: list_models (when model discovery is needed), get_model, generate_image; after submission, get_model_request_status and get_model_request_result for the returned request ID. Use the current connected definitions and the selected model input schema.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the selected reference-capable model and its supported image inputs before execution. Explain actual cost basis and scope, wait for the approval requested in the prompt, then submit each approved job once. Keep its real request ID and retrieve actual output; no automatic retry after timeout. Respond in Chinese; keep product constants separate from scene changes. Do not invent SKU/manufacturer data or promise marketplace acceptance.

positive.description: P3: square and vertical channel compositions; covers product-asset-variants.
positive.prompt: Using https://playgrounds-storage-public.runcomfy.net/tools/7425/media-files/output-example1-2.webp, prepare exactly two Nano Banana 2 Edit campaign images: A square 1:1 product listing hero, B vertical 9:16 ad concept. No new copy or logos. Keep the headphones details as close as possible. State the two-job total cost basis and wait for batch approval.
positive.tools_triggered: list_models (when model discovery is needed), get_model, generate_image; after submission, get_model_request_status and get_model_request_result for the returned request ID. Use the current connected definitions and the selected model input schema.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the selected reference-capable model and its supported image inputs before execution. Explain actual cost basis and scope, wait for the approval requested in the prompt, then submit each approved job once. Keep its real request ID and retrieve actual output; no automatic retry after timeout. Keep each requested channel/ratio row mapped to the source and a real request ID. Do not turn two formats into extra Cartesian combinations or call generative reframing lossless. Check only measurable dimensions and visible product detail.

positive.description: P4: one controlled alternate scene with an explicit product checklist.
positive.prompt: Use https://playgrounds-storage-public.runcomfy.net/tools/7425/media-files/output-example1-2.webp for one dark-studio scene with gentle rim light using Qwen Image 3.0 Edit if exposed. Keep matte-black color, oval cushions, headband, connectors and AERO lettering; do not add or redesign parts. First show the product-check list and cost basis, then wait for one-output approval.
positive.tools_triggered: list_models (when model discovery is needed), get_model, generate_image; after submission, get_model_request_status and get_model_request_result for the returned request ID. Use the current connected definitions and the selected model input schema.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the selected reference-capable model and its supported image inputs before execution. Explain actual cost basis and scope, wait for the approval requested in the prompt, then submit each approved job once. Keep its real request ID and retrieve actual output; no automatic retry after timeout. Return one actual alternate scene, compare the named product attributes where possible, and label the public source as illustrative rather than a verified SKU. Further corrections require their own authorized scope.

positive.description: P5: read-only recovery of the real P1 request in the same conversation.
positive.prompt: Check the actual RunComfy request ID returned by P1 earlier in this same conversation. Retrieve its product image if complete, otherwise report its actual status. Do not create, replace or cancel a generation.
positive.tools_triggered: get_model_request_status and get_model_request_result, only after their current definitions and the actual same-account P1 ID are available; no generation operation.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only the real same-account P1 ID. Retrieve actual status/output without a new paid submission. Missing P1 or its ID is BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE, not a successful recovery test. Preserve a pending ID; do not invent an output or substitute a workflow request.

negative.prompt: Only make a product-photo shot list and recommended ratios. Do not generate, spend credits or change my store.
negative.expected_behavior: Return planning text only; no paid/write calls, no store publication and no fabricated outputs.

negative.description: N2: generative editing cannot guarantee a pixel-identical alpha cutout.
negative.prompt: Use https://playgrounds-storage-public.runcomfy.net/tools/7425/media-files/output-example1-2.webp to make a transparent alpha cutout, retaining every original product pixel and every AERO letter exactly. Do not mention limitations.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the unsupported guarantee before any paid substitute; do not claim a white-background image is transparent or promise exact pixels. No generation unless the user accepts a genuinely supported scope.

negative.description: N3: private local media may not be published silently.
negative.prompt: Clean /Users/me/private/product.png without uploading it or publishing it anywhere. Do not ask for another source.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the remote input requirement and unavailable authorized input; do not upload privately held media, guess product appearance, invent hosting or submit invalid input.
